about: Every background listener AmberX runs, its policy defaults and the microphone priority (listener@1). Data, so core.ts (web), the Dev Console's amberx-listeners plugin (Node core.mjs + Python server) and the docs read one list. The Android twin keeps the ids it uses in ListenerRules.java and checks the defaults against cases.json.

listeners.label: Hands-free (wake word)
listeners.about: Listens for the wake phrases (or everything, when always armed) on screen and with the screen off.

listeners.label: Command after the wake word
listeners.about: One Google utterance after a wake phrase, then back to the silent wake listener.

listeners.label: Speak button
listeners.about: One utterance when you tap Speak or push to talk.

listeners.label: Gizmo talk mode
listeners.about: Hands-free conversation with Gizmo that keeps going with the screen off or AmberX in the background (a notification with Stop).

listeners.label: Recorder microphone
listeners.about: The Audio Output Recorder's opt-in mic track.

listeners.label: axHub watch (approvals)
listeners.about: Reads the approvals feed with the screen off and raises alerts.

listeners.label: Veto alarm
listeners.about: Rings for a held command until you decide it.

listeners.label: Hands-free in this browser
listeners.about: Web Speech recognition while an AmberX tab is open (the phone app listens natively instead).

listeners.label: Dictation
listeners.about: The dictation plugin while it records.

listeners.label: Speak a command (page)
listeners.about: The voice plugin waiting for the next command in a browser.

listeners.label: Assistant microphone
listeners.about: The agent voice console plugin loaded into AmberX.
